title: How do you hire a human? Q&A with Tom Harvey, Stack Overflow technical recruiter
summary: Everybody's resume is perfect now, so how do you find the perfect teammate?
llm_summary: In a candid Q&A with Stack Overflow’s technical recruiter Tom Harvey, the piece explores how hiring has shifted now that most candidates boast polished resumes. Harvey explains that recruiters must dig deeper—focusing on real‑world problem‑solving, cultural fit, and concrete evidence of impact—to spot the truly great teammates amid a sea of “perfect” CVs.
